title: Game window launched error
body: ### Godot version 4.6.3.stable.official.7d41c59c4 ### System information Ubuntu 26.04 LTS (WSL2), X11, Vulkan (llvmpipe) ### Issue description When running a project from the Godot editor (F5), the spawned game window does **not** receive keyboard input. Neither `Input.is_key_pressed()` nor `_unhandled_input()` nor `_input()` receive any keyboard events. Mouse events (clicks, scroll) work fine. Clicking the game window to transfer focus has **no effect** — the window remains unfocused. Code-level workarounds tried without success: - `window.grab_focus()` - `window.always_on_top = true` then `await get_tree().process_frame` then `window.always_on_top = false` ### Steps to reproduce 1. Open Godot editor on Linux 2. Open any project (e.g. a minimal scene with a Node2D and Camera2D) 3. Press F5 to run the project 4. Try pressing WASD or arrow keys — camera does not move 5. Click the game window — still no keyboard response ### Workaround Running the project directly from command line bypasses the issue: ```bash godot -d --path /path/to/project ``` Keyboard input works correctly in this mode. ### Minimal reproduction project Any project will reproduce this — even an empty project. ### Additional context - The issue is specific to launching from the editor GUI; CLI launch works fine - `_process()` runs normally (verified with print statements) - Camera2D reference is valid and enabled - Not a cache issue — occurs even after `rm -rf .godot/` - Occurs consistently across multiple editor restarts
